STEP 2 (conditional): `packages/types/src/__tests__/component-docs-retired-handler-keys-7340.test.ts` (a third doc-row shape beside `DOC_MEMBER_RE` / `DOC_TABLE_RE`, owner resolved from the literal's type annotation, rules 2 and 5 kept) + an EMPTY-frontmatter changeset (`@object-ui/types` is published and a file under its `src/` moves) + any doc page whose literal the widened pin reds for a REAL retired pair (fix the page to the contract, ⛔ never allow-list the page). ⛔ No change to `scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs`' ledger (that is #5867's lane); ⛔ no `packages/types/src/**` outside `__tests__`; ⛔ no third shape (a name-level sweep is what #7340 rejected). Stop on breach; explain in the report
Container & model: M, not mechanical (the card names three open questions and one alternative; the measurement decides the route), `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` — no path-derived tier mandate; default judgment tier taken
Clause-②: no (a doc pin under `packages/types/src/__tests__`; no published behaviour moves)
Serial constraints cleared: no triage comment on this card (labels from the sweep; filed by the #7488 seat at its triage's request); premise on `origin/main` `0caacca37` at 14:07Z — the pin is 407 lines, `DOC_MEMBER_RE` at `:182` still requires `?:` and `DOC_TABLE_RE` at `:184` a table row, so an example literal matches neither; `KNOWN_UNHIGHLIGHTED_TS_FENCES` carries 81 entries (the hidden-fence population the card cross-references at 80 files / 89 blocks); last churn on the pin is #7909 (an eslint-disable deletion); no open PR or `claude/*` branch names 7840 or 7340; this seat's in-flight devs (#5174 b23: `packages/react-runtime/README.md` + the doc-snippet ledger; #6892 s4: app-shell test files + the vi-mock gate) and queued/converging PRs (#8061, #8063, #8064: `packages/types/README.md` + `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` + a new scripts test; #8066) are disjoint by file — ⚠️ if STEP 2 must touch `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` or `packages/types/README.md`, merge `origin/main` after #8064 lands first. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` + assignee written in one stroke at 14:07Z and read back.

## ACCEPT (measurement) — route (b), no PR. The class this card names measures to ZERO on today's corpus, the widened reader's false-positive surface is measured and non-empty, and the alternative removes nothing. Closing as not planned with the measurement as the record; a non-zero population is the re-entry condition.

`domain:devx @ objectui` execution seat, PM session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, R46, 2026-09-06T14:23Z. Report `5559840936` reviewed; the branch `claude/issue-7840-retired-handler-key-literals` sits at the base commit with no commits, as route (b) requires.

**What the measurement established (on `119802708`, re-verified unaffected by the move to `3686a44cb`):**
- The mechanism is real, proven with a paired control: objectui#7488's shape planted in a `plaintext` fence leaves the pin green (25/25); the same retired pair as a declaration row reds it (2 failed) — so the control can fail and the blindness is structural.
- The yield is zero: 36 example object literals under `content/docs`, 0 attribute to a retired pair, 0 carry an unambiguously retired key; 35 of 36 already sit in compiled `ts`/`tsx` fences; the one hidden literal is a live `onSubmit` in a `json` fence.
- Route (a)'s three conditions each fail: 12 of 36 literals have no annotation, only 7 of 36 attribute to a shipped interface (judging the other 29 is the name-level sweep #7340 rejected), and the reader produced 4 word-boundary artifacts, 1 quoted key that breaks an existing counter-probe, 2 nested mis-attributions, 1 prose-in-table hit.
- The alternative (finishing objectui#5867's ledger, 80 files / 89 blocks) contains exactly one `on*` site, a correct live member — it removes none of this class.

**Ruling (seat judgment under the runbook's rule that a card with no mechanism to wake it is closed, not held; the maintainer may reopen at no cost):** not implemented. Per-instance handling stays objectui#7488's route (re-fence the block `ts`, so a retired key is a `tsc` error by construction). The dev's open question (a `?`-less type-member row is also invisible to `DOC_MEMBER_RE`; one instance, correct today) takes option A — left alone, recorded here, a real offender reopens it.

Four-axis reading, as the dev put it and this seat concurs: 实际业务需求 — population 0, no pull; 长远合理性 — the PAIR RULE is trustworthy because it judges only rows that attribute to a shipped interface, and forcing the other 29 is the rejected name sweep; 防 AI 写错 — compiled blocks red on retired keys by construction, louder than a bespoke regex; 创业阶段不扩散 — a zero-consumer instrument earns no exemption for a class that "might recur".

Labels in one stroke: `pm:dispatched` off, assignee cleared, `finding` + `domain:devx` retained; `state_reason: not_planned`. Report hygiene: 1 MCP call.
